title: Document attachment arguments, version 1
description: The canonical arguments a caller hands /acquire for the documents source, and the adapter reads on stdin (docs/design/attachments.md). Written within the descriptor grammar the MCP server serves: objects with primitive fields, no reference, no format, no pattern.

mediaType.description: type/subtype, lowercase, no parameters; version 1 processes application/pdf, text/plain, text/markdown, text/csv and application/json

bytes.description: the document in standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4), padded, no line breaks

sha256.description: optional: the caller's own digest of the bytes, "sha256:" + 64 lowercase hex; refused when it does not match

ocr.description: auto (default): run the configured OCR program for pages with no text layer; never: report them as needing it
